race.comment: PIKLEMEGRANMOTHER (11) is knocking on the door with three runner up finishes in a row, narrowly beaten at Mt Gambier two back before another solid effort at Casterton. Will lob up on speed again and take plenty of catching. MISTER SOLLY (4) has placed in his past three, solid behind two in-form horses here two starts back before a sound effort at Warrnambool. Turns around quickly here and should go close again. LITTLE ALLY BAMA (14) was sound on debut at big odds, working home into fifth. Better for that and have to respect. Very wary of ASAL (1) who comes over from New Zealand, now with the Purcell yard. Imagine he'll get further but this is very winnable.
